description_short: Adds a configurable day-to-night lighting cycle by gently dimming the game's original weather conditions.
description_long: NightMod introduces a day-to-night cycle to Captain of Industry. It does not add new weather types and does not interfere with weather selection - instead it snapshots the game's original weather conditions on load and smoothly dims their lighting (and, optionally, solar panel output) on a repeating cycle. The cycle length, darkness depth and solar effect are configurable, and the whole mod can be toggled on or off before each game load.
